tilda_intro: How TILDA, the bike infrastructure dataset, reads this way. Check the category of the way and of each side. If it does not match what is on the ground, choose the right one under “Change to” and apply the tags. Then fill in what is missing below.
tilda_checks_local: “Checked” and “Verified” are kept in this browser only, not in OpenStreetMap.
tilda_gap_title: Open question: which category is it?
tilda_foot_title: Open question: does the footway next to it belong to this cycleway?
tilda_foot_text: A footway runs right next to it ({side}). If nothing lies between them, this is a segregated foot and cycle path; TILDA reads traffic_mode:right=foot for it.
tilda_foot_left_hint: TILDA only recognizes traffic_mode:right=foot as a segregated foot and cycle path so far; with “left” it stays a cycleway for now.
tilda_foot_no_tooltip: Kept in this browser, not in OpenStreetMap: the footway next to it is not part of this cycleway. The question goes away.
tilda_move_oneway_tooltip: On a footway or path, the direction for bicycles belongs in oneway:bicycle. Sets {tag} and removes {old}.
tilda_collapsed_hint: bike infrastructure is on the sides
tilda_remove_reason: Does not fit the chosen target
tilda_required_for: Needed for the Radnetz dataset as “{category}”
tilda_check_tooltip: Confirm that you looked at this and that the default is right. Kept in this browser, not in OpenStreetMap; needs no upload.
tilda_uncheck_tooltip: Checked. Choose it again to remove the check.
tilda_reminder_tooltip: Confirm that you looked for it. Kept in this browser, not in OpenStreetMap; needs no upload.
tilda_verify_tooltip: Mark this way as verified (a second look). Kept in this browser, not in OpenStreetMap; needs no upload.
tilda_unverify_tooltip: Verified. Choose it again to remove it.
tilda_disabled_new_way: Upload the way first; a check needs its OpenStreetMap id.
tilda_category_bicycleRoad_vehicleDestin: Bicycle road, destination traffic allowed (Anlieger frei)
tilda_category_footAndCyclewayShared_adj: Shared foot and cycle path, along a road
tilda_category_footAndCyclewayShared_iso: Shared foot and cycle path, separate
tilda_category_footAndCyclewayShared_adj: Shared foot and cycle path (along a road?)
tilda_category_footAndCyclewaySegregated: Segregated foot and cycle path, along a road
